intro: A project manager resume that proves delivery: budgets, timelines and teams, with what the project achieved once it landed.
tips: Give each project's budget, timeline and team size.
Say what the project achieved once delivered, not just that it shipped.
List your certification (PMP, PRINCE2) where readers look first.

basics.name: Ahmed Hassan
basics.label: Project Manager, PMP
basics.summary: PMP-certified project manager with nine years delivering construction and fit-out projects up to AED 120m. Known for bringing troubled projects back on schedule.

work.name: Gulf Interiors LLC
highlights: Delivered 14 office fit-outs worth AED 300m in total, 12 on or ahead of schedule.
Took over a hotel refurbishment running 9 weeks late and handed it over 2 weeks behind the original date.
Manage teams of up to 60 site staff and 15 subcontractors.

work.name: Al Noor Construction
highlights: Coordinated design changes and procurement for a 30-storey residential tower.
Introduced weekly look-ahead planning that cut site idle time by a fifth.
